title: Meta’s smart glasses are now prohibited for ICE staffers.
summary: The glasses “could unintentionally capture, record or transmit sensitive information, potentially compromising privacy and legal protections,” ICE acting director David Venturella said in a memo to staff, according to The New York Times .
